        route_dists[r_idx] = compute_route_dist(routes[r_idx])
        route_dists[new_r_idx] = compute_route_dist(routes[new_r_idx])
    
    def apply_swap(routes, r1, pos1, r2, pos2):
        cust1 = routes[r1][pos1]
        cust2 = routes[r2][pos2]
